groups.id: Corpse access, evidence snapshots and body arithmetic
groups.locations: P16 corpse180-305,370-639,641-815,998-1123; autopsy_context1-25; fresh Core autopsy69-139,174-210
groups.trace: Actual actor clock is required by action access. Scene/location and discovering-party checks precede actions. Durable health is copied only with seven entries; recognized injury regions are translated explicitly, not arbitrary vector indexing. Core canonical health indices4/5/6 correspond to chest/stomach/head and native seven-field order agrees. Post-combat health and blood overwrite occurs after transition; durable injury rows are copied by death transition, while returned post_combat_body.injuries are not copied here. Whole outcome-to-durable-limb injury commit order remains a recipient dependency, so missing injury is not asserted from this function alone. Core elapsed age intentionally saturates and handling damage is u16 cumulative aging, not bounded basis points.
groups.disposition: No new proved ordinary numeric failure in these bodies. Preserve ROOT-INITIAL04-F042 source claim about strongest-injury finite-sum ordering; do not reinterpret it as witnessed ordinary combat failure. Body raw admission and transaction integrity remain open dependencies.

groups.id: Retry, revision and fallible action sequences
groups.trace: Receipts intentionally key actor/corpse/action/discipline/stage/expected revision; validated client action ID is not the key. Existing receipt returns before access to make retries idempotent. Expected revision gates every state mutation; examined receipts do not change corpse revision. Internal stage requires opened body; unknown stage rejected before wait. Open validates skill before wait, whereas examine resolves skill after wait. Wait false returns without receipt. Bury/exhume/open handling and revision use saturating arithmetic; handling is an aging accumulator allowed beyond10000. Revision saturation at u32MAX merits policy review but no normal reachable MAX witness or unbounded canonical producer was traced. Mutation then fallible filth/social/evidence recipient requires actual outer transaction/caught-error semantics before alleging committed partial state.
groups.disposition: No new current partial-commit or retry defect is claimed. Action identity/semantic dedup may be intentional and cannot be declared defective merely because action_id is unused. Revision saturation is contract-strengthening qualification, not a newly counted ordinary failure.

groups.id: Permission draws, familiarity and topic chronology
groups.trace: Draw index10001 maps exactly to0..10000 then safe u16 narrowing or normalized f32 coefficient0..1. Familiarity saturating product then division/min preserves0..10000 and safe cast. u64 minutes as f32 divided60 remains finite. Canonical_pair rejects self; attempts are persisted once per party/resident/scope/approach. Finite difficulty constants enumerate authority and scope. Language min uses actual oral hours/instinct; recipient admission remains separate. permission_topics_for_npc1864 uses now(...).unwrap_or_default and thus presents missing clock as epoch0, changing scene/interment availability. This is another actual receiver of existing missing-clock finding, not genuine zero time. Demo victimID saturating subtraction is only called with fixed high fixture IDs; no invented live identity-zero witness.
